## What

One or two sentences on what this PR changes and why. Link the issue or ADR if there is one.

## Checklist

- [ ] `dotnet build`, `dotnet test`, and `dotnet format --verify-no-changes` pass locally
- [ ] New behaviour has tests; bug fixes have a test that failed before the fix
- [ ] Domain names match `docs/domain/glossary.md` (new terms added)
- [ ] Hard-to-reverse decisions have an ADR in `docs/adr/`
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` and docs still describe reality after this change

## Notes for the reviewer

Anything surprising, any trade-off, anything you are unsure about.
